g.title: URL_MINIMIZED_DFA
g.text: DFA symbol partition: h | t | p | s | LOWER = [a-z] minus {h,t,p,s} | DIGIT = [0-9] | : | / | . | - | _ | ~ | OTHER

g.title: completion
g.text: For every state and every class in Sigma,
any class not printed on an outgoing edge
transitions to sink. sink loops on Sigma.
See minimization.md for the expanded table.
